## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you want to propose.

## Motivation
Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you imagine this feature working.

## Custody / trust-boundary impact
Does this touch intent verification, settlement, the ledger, or how a user
confirms a payment? If so, explain how it preserves the non-custodial model
(see [DESIGN.md](../../DESIGN.md)) — this is required for anything on the
money-movement path.

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternatives? Describe them here.

## Acceptance Criteria
How would you verify that this feature is working correctly?
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
